summary: Stratigraphic occurrences of extinct vertebrates (PBDB, 273,750 occurrences) and a phylogenetic framework (Open Tree) are open and queryable, but the morphological character matrices needed to measure gaps between classes were not reachable (MorphoBank returned 403 to every request). The one matrix found, Lloyd 2018 on Dryad, covers coelurosaurian theropods (the bird side of the dinosaur-bird transition) only.
next_step: Obtain MorphoBank matrices (or the underlying publications' supplements) for theropod-bird, synapsid-mammal and fish-tetrapod transitions via a browser or the MorphoBank project API, then pre-register disparity with and without stem fossils.
obstacles_confirmed: MorphoBank blocks non-browser clients (HTTP 403), so no class-spanning matrix could be confirmed.
PBDB records occurrences and ages but no morphology.
